I fixed it with a one-line change in `packages/compiler-core/src/tokenizer.ts` (`stateInRCDATA`). **Cause:** the tokenizer reads the inside of `` now gives one plain-text node: `{{ foo
bar
`. - The existing compiler-core and compiler-dom tests all pass (744 tests). I ran that parse check from a temporary test file and deleted it afterwards, so I haven't added a regression test.
